What is Service Suspension?

Service Suspension is a process that places an organization's
accounts-payable invoice payment process on hold. The ePayables system
automatically suspends invoice payment if the invoice has not been approved
by the specified date. This action applies only to the invoice in question
and does not suspend payment of other invoices.

The ePayables system generates an e-mail notification to you and other
interested individuals when a service suspension event occurs.  The
notification includes information regarding the invoice and the
organization's service suspension status.

Service Suspension is the default method to control invoice payment
processes.  If you wish to change your accounts payable services, please
contact your <ORG> representative.

body: Confidential: Updated 2026 Salary and Bonus Guidelines (<DATE>)

Attached please find the updated 2026 Salary and Bonus Guidelines.  Due to recent changes in employment law we encourage you to read the documents carefully, as there are new guidelines, procedures and forms.  The 2026 Guidelines are in effect immediately.

The Guidelines include a new bonus criteria that is based on ETS's overall performance, the cost of living, the employee's individual contribution and overall performance.  The bonus criteria is attached to the 2026 guidelines.  The bonus calculation formula is as follows:
Bonus = (ETS's Overall Performance x Cost of Living x Individual Contribution and Overall Performance) x 1% 
Note:  1% is the designated bonus pool allocation to employees who are eligible for the 2026 bonus guidelines

We believe it is important that employees understand how the bonus calculation works.  Each employee's individual contribution to their department and to ETS overall will be determined by their supervisor and will be used in the bonus calculation.  It is not an award or a recommendation.  Also, the bonus criteria does not carry the same weight of importance as the salary review process.  The salary review process will continue, with the PRC committee making the final decision about salary increases.  

The bonus pool amount can be affected by changes in ETS's overall performance, whether or not the company meets its budget or any other factors that the PRC committee deems appropriate.

A summary list of the Foundation's activities would be useful in helping us to better understand how the Foundation's support has impacted the lives of people around the world.

Please send to me by close of business on Friday (<DATE>) a short summary paragraph describing how one or more grants have made a positive impact on the lives of individuals or communities. The goal is to have a few sentences that describe our work in broad terms to give an indication of the scope of our work.  The summary should not exceed 100 words.

If possible, please send to me an example of your work that would complement your summary of <DATE> words.  It would be great if we can include a link or web address in your summary to the example of your work.
